success.name: California Environmental Youth Advisory Council (CalEPA)
success.description: This is an especially strong match because applicants ages 14–20 can help shape environmental policy, work with California environmental decision-makers, and build leadership and networking skills. Applications for the inaugural cohort are open through September 21, 2026.

success.name: American River Parkway Foundation
success.description: ARPF offers youth-friendly environmental volunteer projects such as river cleanups, invasive-plant removal, habitat restoration, and trail maintenance. These activities can provide community-service hours while developing teamwork and connections with other volunteers.

success.name: Sacramento County Voter Registration & Elections – Vote Center Program
success.description: Because the user is 16, they are eligible to work at a Sacramento County Vote Center and receive community-service hours. This is a strong politics-related opportunity for learning about elections, meeting people involved in civic work, and gaining practical experience.
